# GrantFlow AI

> AI co-pilot that helps founders structure ideas, draft grant applications, match against a curated grant database, and build a roadmap from idea to launch.

GrantFlow AI turns a rough idea into a fundable plan: it scores how well your idea fits real grants, drafts tailored applications section by section, and outlines the next steps to execute. Built by FOQUS, a Swedish branding, web design, video production and SEO agency.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, how it works, and the live idea-to-plan generator.
- [About](/about): Why GrantFlow exists, the team, and the pre-launch waitlist.
